g.text: ON CONFLICT (dm_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
publish dm.created to user:{alice} and user:{bob}
[conflict (exists, or another request won the race)]
From here a DM is just a channel: same WS endpoint, voice pipeline,
ordering, playback queue, receipts and transcription.
anyone else gets 404 for the channel, its messages and its audio.
"online" = the peer has a /ws/me socket open (any tab or device).
